name: net_enemy_census_waves_provenance
description: Read-only provenance diagnostic derived from all44 unchanged net_enemy_sync_waves steps in their exact original order, including its9 native900ms movement pulses, count-only readiness, host7damage, and strict HP assertion. Inserts checked native list/controller/cache/actor+9E8/+9F0 provenance before movement, three samples after the original4000ms settle/count readiness, and one immediately before the unchanged HP assertion. Count readiness is not identity parity; captures retain unmatched/extras. The known native population/refill divergence must still fail the original assertion, never become an expected-pass exception. Census windows perturb timing; no causal equivalence to the original run is assumed. Incomplete collection fails with partial evidence and may prevent reaching the retained assertion. The first live diagnostic run (20261002-234801) failed before movement because peer2 was still in its runtime-triggered load (zero native roots/inField, no completed arrival). A bounded read-only readiness wait now requires each peer latest lifecycle/session-boundary log to be a completed nonzero-epoch arrival at the current full target location, safe native gameplay flags, valid head/tail pointers, and nonempty actor candidates before the unchanged first census. The wait does not certify census completeness or parity, retry census observations, or discard incomplete evidence. The revised run20261002-235825 failed strict collection with host descriptor PermissionError before damage. Run20261003-001955 passed48steps with complete censuses, four native enemies per peer at160 then153HP and four client deaths each, but its second wave was empty and controller count remained2: bounded first-pack HP/death proof only, not multi-wave/barrier acceptance. The intermittent access-denied cause remains unproven.
